name: Default administrator credentials
description: The factory administrator login authenticates to a protected configuration endpoint.
remediation: Change the factory administrator password and restrict administrative access.

name: Anonymous REST configuration access
description: Administrative workspace configuration is readable without authentication.
remediation: Restrict configuration REST endpoints to the intended authenticated administrative roles.

name: Anonymous GeoWebCache configuration access
description: A cache layer configuration is readable without authentication; public tile services are not assessed as private.
remediation: Restrict GeoWebCache configuration REST access while retaining intended public tile access.

name: Anonymous server diagnostics
description: Server status or system metrics are readable through an unauthenticated administrative REST endpoint.
remediation: Require administrative authentication for status and system-diagnostic endpoints.

name: Verbose service error disclosure
description: A bounded invalid service request reveals Java stack traces, SQL statements, or internal filesystem paths.
remediation: Disable verbose exception reporting in production and retain detailed errors in protected server logs.

name: Exposed configuration files or directory listing
description: A known private configuration/backup path or GeoServer data directory is served over HTTP.
remediation: Keep the data directory and WEB-INF outside public static-file mappings; remove public backups and directory indexes.

name: Declared private layer readable anonymously
description: A layer explicitly declared private by the operator returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection without authentication.
remediation: Apply layer read rules for the intended roles and verify anonymous WFS access is denied.

name: Untrusted credentialed CORS policy
description: A configuration endpoint reflects untrusted origins and permits credentialed browser requests; authenticated data access is not demonstrated.
remediation: Allow only trusted origins for credentialed administrative routes; public-map wildcard CORS is not this finding.

name: Production transport hardening
description: A deployment explicitly declared production serves its administration page without HTTPS enforcement, or lacks HSTS on HTTPS.
remediation: Enforce HTTPS for production administration and configure an appropriate Strict-Transport-Security policy.

name: Session cookie hardening
description: A session cookie lacks HttpOnly, lacks Secure over HTTPS, or uses SameSite=None without Secure.
remediation: Set HttpOnly on session cookies and Secure over HTTPS; choose SameSite deliberately for the authentication flow.

name: Administration page browser protections
description: The administration HTML page lacks an enforced CSP, effective framing restrictions, or MIME-sniffing protection.
remediation: Configure an enforced CSP, frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on administration HTML.
